final_parameter_training.purpose: After the rules are frozen using walk-forward results, fit the final parameter set here without reading final_test.

leakage_guards: Every OOS period occurs strictly after its training period.
The existing final_test period is excluded from every fold.
All tickers use the same global trading-date boundaries.
selection_scope_note: VCB is a fixed prototype ticker. Earlier walk-forward folds test grid-parameter robustness, not point-in-time ticker selection. The final holdout remains valid because the ticker choice used development data only.
